title: Grateful Dead Live at Universal Amphitheatre on 1973-07-01
lineage: R1 > Technics RS-1506 > TEAC AN-300 [Dolby Decode] > Grace Design Lunatec V3 [Pre-Only] > Korg MR-1000 > DSF [1-bit 5.6448 MHz Stereo] > Korg AudioGate > WAV [24/96]
source: Sony ECM-22P > Sony TC-770 > MAR > ?? [Dolby Encode] > R1

ai_review.summary: An outstanding audience tape with crystal‑clear mix and hot ’73 performance, highlighted by a scorching Playin', stellar China > Rider segue and the best Loose Lucy heard.
ai_review.review: The recording captures an exceptionally vivid audience sound – clear, well‑balanced and full of crowd ambience – that lets listeners hear Jerry’s electrified guitar work and a blazing Playin'. The show itself is a quintessential ’73 set: hot, swinging and packed with standouts like China > Rider, Big River, Loose Lucy and an epic long Playin', despite a few comments about Phil’s bass and the drums being slightly recessed.

ai_rating.rationale: The majority of reviews are 4‑5 stars praising both performance and tape quality; only one moderate review notes minor balance issues, resulting in a strong overall rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Very clear audience recording with excellent band‑and‑crowd mix; slight mids boost makes Phil's bass and the drums a bit recessed for some listeners, but overall highly listenable.

show_quality.setlist_flow: A hot, swinging ’73 set with seamless transitions and high energy throughout; the band stays tight despite occasional balance quirks.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Garcia is described as front‑and‑center, crisp, electrified and on his game for the whole show.
band_member_comments.Phil: Mixed feedback – some find his bass hard to hear due to mids, while others say it sounds good after adjusting levels.
band_member_comments.Drums: Generally praised as strong and driving; a few listeners note drums are slightly recessed in the mix.
